title: Woomera range chief's grandfather in secret British UFO investigations

tellings.quote: grandfather was involved in secret investigations with the British government in the late 1950s late 1940s in Britain with the UFOs.

plain: A man named Rhys Dalton Morgan, who ran Woomera, a rocket and weapons testing range in Australia, says his grandfather took part in secret UFO investigations for the British government in Britain in the late 1940s and 1950s. The Australian journalist Ross Coulthart passes this on from what Morgan told him. If true, it would mean Britain was quietly studying UFOs soon after the Second World War.
